cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX is an XML-based format for GPS data, widely used by GPS devices and fitness tracking applications.

cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed version of KML (Keyhole Markup Language), reducing file size for easier sharing and faster loading in Google Earth.

cards.title: Why Convert GPX to KMZ?
items: Smaller file size compared to GPX and KML
Native support in Google Earth and Google Maps
Can include images and other resources in one file
Faster loading and easier to share
